Academic training · blog series

Student internship guides by institute

In short: These Mind Grace blog guides are written for students of specific Delhi NCR universities, colleges, and hospitals. Each one covers programmes, syllabus highlights, mandated practicum hours, documentation, and how a supervised clinic placement east of the Yamuna can fit your course requirements.

Start with the internship enquiry guide for how supervision and documentation work at Mind Grace, then open the page for your own institute below. For a wider comparison, read Psychology institutions in Delhi NCR.
